facts.fact: The EPF interest rate for FY 2025-26 is 8.25% per annum, as recommended by the EPFO Central Board of Trustees
facts.quote: After due deliberations, CBT recommended 8.25 % annual rate of interest to be credited on EPF accumulations in members’ accounts for the financial year 2025-26.

facts.fact: The recommendation was made at the CBT's 239th meeting (PIB release of 2 March 2026)
facts.quote: Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya Chairs 239th meeting of Central Board of Trustees (CBT), EPF Central Board recommends 8.25% rate of interest on EPF to its subscribers for FY 2025-26

facts.fact: The PIB release on the 239th CBT meeting is dated 2 March 2026
facts.quote: Posted On: 02 MAR 2026 3:37PM by PIB Delhi

facts.fact: The 8.25% rate for 2025-26 has since been notified and EPFO offices directed to credit it to members' accounts (News On AIR, 1 July 2026)
facts.quote: EPFO has officially notified an 8.25 percent interest rate on EPF deposits for financial year 2025-26.

facts.fact: 8.15% was the EPF rate for FY 2022-23 (an older year, not 2025-26)
facts.quote: The Central Board recommended 8.15 % annual rate of interest to be credited on EPF accumulations in members’ accounts for the financial year 2022-23.

facts.fact: 8.5% was the EPF rate for FY 2020-21 (an older year, not 2025-26)
facts.quote: The Central Board recommended 8.50% annual rate of interest to be credited on EPF accumulations in members’ accounts for the financial year 2020-21.

summary: Confirmed: 8.25% for FY 2025-26 (239th CBT, PIB 2 Mar 2026), notified for crediting (News On AIR, 1 Jul 2026); 8.15% (2022-23) and 8.5% (2020-21) are older years.
